semantics.points: One record per ISO 639-3; no merging or deduplication of coincident positions. Highlight overlays are not additional languages.
semantics.coordinates: log10(NCC), log10(sample equivalents); no power transform.
semantics.missing: Pre-training cluster -1 is omitted. Post-training cluster -1 uses a categorical strip; jitter is not quantity.
semantics.clusters: Saved index labels and regimes, never recomputed from quantity thresholds.
semantics.intervals: Original paper display expansion in log10 space. Display endpoints are not true 95% confidence bounds.
